requirement: Describe the Phase III prospective multicenter parallel study with a 16-week double-blind randomized placebo-controlled period followed by a 24-week open-label extension.

evidence.text: The protocol identifies the Phase III design and the blinded and extension periods.

requirement: State 1:1 randomization to Octagam 10% 2.0 g/kg or matching placebo, stratified by physician global disease activity, during the first period.

evidence.text: The protocol defines treatment and identifies global disease activity as the randomization stratum.

requirement: Define the primary endpoint as Week-16 responder status: TIS increase from baseline of at least 20 points with no confirmed deterioration at two consecutive visits through Week 16.
acceptable_values: no confirmed deterioration at two consecutive visits

evidence.text: The protocol gives the complete binary responder definition.

requirement: Frame the primary contrast as the difference in Week-16 responder proportions for randomized Octagam versus placebo, with deterioration, early withdrawal, or absent Week-16 response treated as nonresponse.

evidence.text: The protocol binds the endpoint to all randomized subjects and classifies deterioration as nonresponse.
The SAP operationalizes missing Week-16 values and early withdrawal as nonresponse.

requirement: Define FAS according to ITT as all randomized participants and make its Week-16 primary analysis the principal study result.

evidence.text: The SAP defines FAS as all randomized subjects and names the FAS analysis primary.

requirement: Use PP1 as a supportive Week-16 population excluding FAS participants with significant pre-Week-16 deviations, while retaining clinical deterioration and efficacy-related withdrawal as nonresponse.

evidence.text: The SAP defines PP1 and its handling of deterioration and withdrawal.

requirement: Define the safety set as every participant receiving any part of an Octagam or placebo infusion and attribute adverse events to the most recent treatment actually received.

requirement: Compare primary responder proportions with a Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel test stratified by global disease activity and report an exact two-sided 95% confidence interval for the Octagam-minus-placebo risk difference.

requirement: Use two-sided alpha 0.05 for the confirmatory Week-16 responder comparison.

requirement: Declare efficacy success only if the Octagam Week-16 responder proportion is statistically significantly higher than placebo in the stratified primary analysis.

requirement: Include a sensitivity logistic-regression analysis for Week-16 response with treatment, global disease activity, and prespecified applicable baseline variables.
